purpose: Standalone transparent Eugene, original lanky game-character proportions, head turned to picture-left, simple squinting eye and exuberant uninhibited dance pose.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Edit this approved original-proportioned Eugene dancing cutout. The user approves the return to his simple original form and now asks: TURN HIS HEAD AND GAZE IN THE OTHER DIRECTION, give him SQUINTING EYES WITH DANCING FERVOR, and REALLY SHOW HIM MAKING A SPECTACLE OF HIMSELF. Make Eugene hilariously, exuberantly lost in the music while retaining the simple lanky game character, NOT a chibi or a muscular hero.

HEAD DIRECTION — CRITICAL: in this input the muzzle points toward the RIGHT edge of the picture. Turn his head so the long lavender-ended muzzle instead points toward the LEFT EDGE OF THE PICTURE. The head should be a clear left-facing three-quarter-to-near-profile view, not front-on and not right-facing. His attention/gaze is to picture-left. A little upward head toss/tilt adds delighted dance fervor, but do not twist his neck impossibly.

EXPRESSION: his original TINY black bead eyes are now squeezed down into equally TINY simple black curved SLITS, as if he is dancing with his eyes nearly closed in bliss. Keep this mark extremely simple and small, with no whites, big eyelids, eyelashes, brows, human facial musculature or big cartoon eyes. Give the plain angular horse mouth a modest delighted open shape, as if happily whooping along, keeping the original simple short dark mouth opening and at most a small plain pale tooth edge. No exaggerated human smile, tongue sticking out, giant buck teeth, cheek bulges or cute round face.

DANCING SPECTACLE: exaggerate his current LOW BENT-KNEE DISCO GROOVE into an uninhibited, slightly uncoordinated moment. Keep both knees bent and one knee angled outward, with his thin legs and small pink shoes planted/stepping naturally, hips swung hard to one side, skinny torso twisting and leaning back a little, shoulders at different heights. One thin arm swings outward with a bent elbow and a loose FLOPPY WRIST, hand around shoulder height and fingers loosely splayed; the other bent arm swings lower across/away from his waist, with a relaxed open pink hand. Do not point with an index finger or recreate the earlier pointing-to-the-ball pose. The hands should be expressive and loose, not fists or formal ballet shapes. Think earnest awkward lanky guy giving the dance absolutely everything with no self-consciousness. A clear lively readable silhouette with comic asymmetry and strong dance energy; no extra limbs, impossible balance, broken joints or literal motion trails. Exactly two arms/hands and two legs/shoes. Keep the whole character inside the canvas.

PRESERVE ORIGINAL FORM: long flat wedge-shaped PINK horse head made of a few large broad angular planes, elongated horizontal snout, pale lavender squared muzzle, long thin neck, two slim ears, ONE straight slender pastel pearlescent horn, short rigid blocky rainbow mane with horizontal mint/yellow/pink/lavender bands. Small head relative to the lanky adult body, narrow sloping shoulders, slim long torso, long thin arms and legs, small low-profile footwear. No muscles, round baby pony head, big cheeks, button nose, enlarged eyes, bulky thighs, inflated hands or oversized sneakers. Retain the rather plain original-game character shape that the user just approved.

COSTUME AND RENDER: the same pale aqua TURTLENECK sweater, sage-mint high collar/cuffs, small purple/white unicorn emblem, pale butter-yellow cuffed trousers and simple pink shoes with thin pale soles. Same large low-poly facets, pastel base colors, warm gold edge light and restrained cyan/magenta disco reflections ON THE CHARACTER. Do not add costume accessories, glasses, helmet, musical props or a background.

OUTPUT: one standalone transparent character RGBA PNG on a 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas. Provide clear margins around full horn, every hand/finger and both shoes, adjusting the new pose's scale slightly if necessary. The transparent cutout contains ONLY Eugene, with clean opaque interiors and antialiased edges. All space outside and between limbs is alpha zero. No floor, tiles, ground, shadows, reflections, spotlight, disco ball, crowd, halo, glow cloud, speed lines, duplicate limbs, backdrop, checkerboard, text, border or watermark. Most important: LEFT-FACING head, tiny squint marks, gleefully over-the-top dancing, faithfully simple original adult lanky proportions.
